name: Felsworn: Twin Slice needs an off-hand weapon, so a staff is refused for its empty off hand and two one-handers strike with both (#400)
contract: Twin Slice rank 2 501257 (Spell.dbc; every rank 801901, 501257-501261 alike) has EquippedItemClass 2 with EquippedItemSubClassMask 173555 (axe, 2H axe, mace, 2H mace, polearm, sword, 2H sword, staff, fist, dagger, spear: every melee weapon, which the client prints as 'Requires Melee Weapon') and AttributesEx3 SPELL_ATTR3_REQUIRES_MAIN_HAND_WEAPON | SPELL_ATTR3_REQUIRES_OFF_HAND_WEAPON. Its description is 'Strike with both weapons for $808305s2% Weapon Damage plus $s1 with each strike'; its effects trigger 808305 (main-hand strike, SPELL_ATTR3_REQUIRES_MAIN_HAND_WEAPON) and 808306 (off-hand strike, SPELL_ATTR3_REQUIRES_OFF_HAND_WEAPON). A staff is a melee weapon that fits the class mask, but it is two-handed and leaves the off hand empty. Expected: with only a staff the cast is refused with SPELL_FAILED_EQUIPPED_ITEM_CLASS_OFFHAND (31), not SPELL_FAILED_EQUIPPED_ITEM_CLASS (29) or _MAINHAND (30), and deals no damage; with a one-handed sword and a dagger it is accepted and both the main-hand and the off-hand strike deal damage. The Felsworn live baseline includes Staves 227, One-Handed Swords 201, Daggers 1180 and Dual Wield 674; they are learned here as fixture setup.
